interpretation_ko: 명예로운 재산을 쌓으려는 싸움에서 자신을 꺾으려는 어떤 시도도 물리칠 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will baffle any attempt to defeat you in the struggle for the up-building of an honorable fortune

cite.original:
To dream that you are weaving, denotes that you will baffle
any attempt to defeat you in the struggle for the up-building
of an honorable fortune.
cite.translation_ko: 스스로 베를 짜는 꿈은, 명예로운 재산을 쌓으려는 싸움에서 자신을 꺾으려는 어떤 시도도 물리칠 조짐이다

interpretation_en: shows that you will be surrounded by healthy and energetic conditions

cite.original:
To see others weaving shows that you will be surrounded by healthy
and energetic conditions.
cite.translation_ko: 남이 베를 짜는 것을 보는 꿈은, 건강하고 활기찬 환경에 둘러싸일 조짐이다
